title: Awesome pan set
text: Awesome pan set. I have been at odds with non-stick pans for a long time, these have been fantastic. I have had zero sticking that is not easily scrapped with a spatula with every use. I have also been able to throw them in the dishwasher, and they actually get clean. I will probably continue with this line moving forward.

product_metadata.title: T-fal Ultimate Hard Anodized Nonstick Fry Pan Set 10, 12 Inch Cookware, Pots and Pans, Dishwasher Safe Grey
features: BUILT TO PERFORM: A true workhorse in the kitchen, hard anodized aluminum retains perfect heat and has a much stronger protective layer than the original metal, making it corrosion and scratch resistant, plus it won’t react to acidic foods

HEAT MASTERY SYSTEM: T-fal's Heat Mastery System is a three ingredient recipe for perfectly delicious cooking results every time…superior and longer-lasting non-stick coating, an anti-warping, even heat base and patented Thermo-Spot technology

THERMO-SPOT INDICATOR: The ring around the spot turns solid red to show when pans are perfectly preheated and ready for ingredients to be added—proper preheating is key to sealing in flavor and cooking food evenly

DURABLE NONSTICK: Hard Titanium reinforced, scratch resistant and toxin-free nonstick interior stands up to everyday use and keeps food sliding smoothly along the surface, making cooking easier and cleanup a breeze
RIVETED HANDLES: Riveted silicone handles are designed for comfort and safety
USE & CARE: Suitable for all stove tops (except induction); oven safe up to 400°F; dishwasher safe; PFOA, lead, and cadmium free
description: Enjoy reliable cooking performance with T fal Ultimate hard anodized nonstick cookware. Its innovative Thermo Spot heat indicator lets you know when the pans are properly pre heated—a critical component to sealing in moisture and delicious flavor, whether sautéing vegetables or searing steak. When the pattern in the center turns to a solid red spot, the pan is hot and ready to cook. The cookware’s hard anodized aluminum construction heats quickly and offers long lasting strength, while its warp resistant even heat base distributes heat evenly throughout for optimal cooking results. Use the cookware on any cook top, except for induction. PFOA , Lead , and Cadmium free, the cookware’s durable Expert nonstick interior offers a health conscious option, effortless food release (little to no fat or oil needed), and easy cleaning. The T fal Ultimate 8 inch and 10 inch saute pans feature tall sides and a wide base that make it useful for a wide range of cooking techniques, from browning and frying to sautéing vegetables or searing fish. Even more, the pan’s vented tempered glass lid traps in heat and moisture, while its silicone stay cool handles come riveted for strength and offer a secure and comfortable hold. Oven safe up to 400 degrees F (lid up to 350 degrees F) and dishwasher safe.
